description: Second Brain means: a second memory. It is a store for your knowledge. You write important thoughts into notes. The notes live in an app. You can connect the notes with each other. And you can search them. So you need to remember less. But be careful: collecting alone does not help. Your notes should turn into something new. For example a text or an idea. Only then do you really learn.
example: You read a good text. You write down the main idea. In your own words. Later you search for it. And you find the idea right away.
